scope: Owner-authorized current paper-only WAIT and existing trading corrections
required_behaviors: Independent LOBSTER LONG, LOBSTER SHORT, CAP LONG, CAP SHORT
Completed Entry-style doji before SMALL; inclusive 0.25 and 0.50 ATR
Bridge priority, refresh, medium/doji/opposite BIG keep; no expiry
Independent live WAIT formation remains unchanged; Owner-added common swing qualification applies to every actual entry, including WAIT
Every entry passes six-closed-candle data validation, aligned latest closed MA5 move >=0.05 ATR, and fresh completed MA5 pivot or MA5/MA15 cross; valid only in immediately following live candle

Every authority including KC_LIVE_BODY_BREAKOUT and KC_2BAR_CONFIRM enforces six-closed-candle efficiency >=70%, middle crosses <=1 and mean body overlap <=50%; no breakout chop exemption; final proof records chop_limits_exempt=false
Frozen preceding ATR and valid authoritative market data
No downtime reconstruction; suspend while held and rebuild after confirmed FLAT
Shared firewall and refreshed half-wallet submit lock
Stable single claims per BIG candle; UNKNOWN quarantine across authorities
Positive actual position consumption including partial fill; no top-up
Persisted claims, position UUID and event outbox; persistence failure blocks submission
Real same-side KC2BAR coexistence and opposite-authority fail-closed arbitration

Owner-approved outer-rail MA5 exit additionally requires a post-entry completed price pivot confirmed by both adjacent completed candles, latest completed MA5 adverse slope and opposite latest-two-completed KC middle slope; ordinary adverse candles and aligned/flat KC never create this exit; preserve observed outer excursion, live adverse slope, 0.10 ATR MA5 and 0.15 ATR price retreat; revoke older retries lacking version-4 closed confirmations
Preserve half-wallet sizing, CAP progress, account hard stops and waterfalls; no standalone KC reversal exit or auto-reverse
Read-only web never starts trading and cannot mutate positions by GET
Fresh aggTrade and ticker feeds share display quotes without older-feed rewind; silent ticker waits time out after five seconds to existing REST fallback; supervisor restores dead market tasks

Held valuation uses qty and a matching mark price for both directions; dashboard Vue 3 polling updates positions and PnL without $set and preserves newer live valuation over older full-status responses; per-symbol quote age is explicit
